label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Championship Leaders
items.text: Michael Brennan and Beau Hossler are tied for the lead at 16-under after round 3, followed by Tom Kim at 15-under and Alex Smalley and Alex Noren at 14-under heading into Sunday’s final round.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau PGA Tour Future
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau wants to play PGA Tour events again, but PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp confirmed there are no merger talks with LIV Golf, keeping DeChambeau and LIV players outside regular Tour access.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy FedEx Cup Plans
items.text: Rory McIlroy reversed last year’s decision by confirming he will play next week’s FedEx St. Jude Championship, despite not being "enthused" about the FedEx Cup playoffs format.
